component.name: SculptForge
component.summary: Digital sculpting for artists and game pipelines

description.p: SculptForge is a free and open-source alternative to ZBrush: a digital sculpting application with familiar brushes, symmetry, sculpt layers, voxel remeshing and one-click LOD chains.

It exports game-ready FBX, glTF and OpenUSD files, can send assets straight into the Unreal Editor, works with Gaussian splats, and includes free AI tools (or bring your own): describe a brush in words, or turn an image or a description into a sculptable 3D model.
ZBrush, GoZ, MatCap, FiberMesh, LightCap and other ZBrush feature names are trademarks of Maxon Computer GmbH. SculptForge is not affiliated with or endorsed by Maxon.
This FlatPark package installs SculptForge's official Linux build, unmodified, from the project's GitHub releases. It is maintained with the SculptForge developers.

The sandbox can read and write your home folder (models name their textures and other files beside them). To use a SpaceMouse, allow input devices once with flatpak override --user --device=input org.sculptforge.SculptForge (on Flatpak older than 1.15.6, --device=all instead).
